cases.explain: «В» answering «куда?» (motion towards a place) takes the accusative, so Лобня becomes Лобню.

cases.sentence: Ровно тридцать лет я живу на ___.
cases.explain: «На» meaning location, not direction, requires the prepositional; жить на свете ('to live in the world') is a fixed phrase with this case.

cases.sentence: Она сама сделала за меня мой выбор, погладив меня по щеке своею ___.
cases.explain: The means or instrument of an action stands in the instrumental with no preposition; -ою is a bookish variant of the ending -ой.
The preposition «по» governs the dative here, in the set expression по счету ('in order, by count').
Negated existence with «не было» puts the thing that is missing into the genitive, here the genitive plural намерений.

cases.sentence: Но красивее всего у нее ___, конечно.
cases.explain: The word is the subject of the sentence (what is beautiful), so it stands in the nominative — here the nominative plural.

cases.sentence: Я так забалдел от истомы, что выпил ___ и бросил счет.
cases.explain: After выпить the drink can go into the partitive genitive, meaning 'some of it' rather than the whole thing.

reading.question: Which two ways of behaving is Venichka choosing between?
reading.explain: He asks himself whether to be threatening or charming, unable to decide how to approach her.

reading.question: How does Venichka sum up his own attitude towards women?
options: He was always frightened of them
reading.explain: He says he was contradictory and then lists what attracted him and what immediately spoiled the attraction.

reading.question: What happens to Venichka's blissful feeling when he remembers that women stabbed Marat with a penknife?
options: It makes him want another drink
reading.explain: Each pleasant thought about women is immediately cancelled by a grievance, and the bliss is killed.

reading.ru: Она сама – сама сделала за меня мой выбор, запрокинувшись и погладив меня по щеке своею лодыжкою.
reading.question: Who settles Venichka's dilemma about how to behave, and how?
options: She does, by leaning back and stroking his cheek with her ankle
He does, by deciding to be rude
reading.correct: She does, by leaning back and stroking his cheek with her ankle
reading.explain: He cannot choose between being gentle and being rough, so she makes the choice for him with that gesture.

reading.ru: Но красивее всего у нее предплечья, конечно.
reading.question: Which part of her does Venichka call the most beautiful of all?
reading.explain: He singles out her forearms, especially when she moves them and laughs while teasing him.

reading.ru: Во всяком случае, когда я ее раскусил до конца, яду там совсем не оказалось, там была малина со сливками.
reading.question: What did Venichka find when he had finally seen through her supposed venomousness?
options: No poison at all, but raspberries and cream
More poison than he had feared
reading.correct: No poison at all, but raspberries and cream
reading.explain: He dismisses her poisonousness as self-defence and says that underneath there was raspberries and cream.

reading.ru: Давай, давай всю нашу жизнь будем вместе!
reading.question: What does Venichka propose to her one Friday when he is tipsy from zubrovka?
options: That they spend their whole life together
That she lend him money for drink
That they go and look at the Kremlin
That they stop seeing each other
reading.correct: That they spend their whole life together
reading.explain: He proposes a life together, promising to take her to Lobnya, dress her in purple and fine linen and earn money on telephone boxes.

reading.ru: А она – молча протянула мне шиш.
reading.question: How does she answer his proposal that they live their whole life together?
options: Silently, by holding out a rude fig gesture to him
By agreeing at once and kissing him
By laughing and pouring him another drink
By getting off the train without a word
reading.correct: Silently, by holding out a rude fig gesture to him
reading.explain: She says nothing and offers him a шиш (fig sign); he sniffs it languidly and bursts into tears.

reading.question: What does she do when Venichka asks 'but why?' a second time?
options: She gives him a second fig gesture
She turns away and says nothing at all
She hands him a glass of zubrovka
reading.correct: She gives him a second fig gesture
reading.explain: Only after the third, imploring 'why?' does she burst into tears and hang on his neck.

reading.ru: Но сегодня – сегодня что-то решится, потому что сегодняшняя пятница – тринадцатая по счету.
reading.question: Why does Venichka expect that today something will finally be decided?
options: Because today's Friday is the thirteenth in the series
Because he has at last saved enough money
Because she promised him an answer
Because the train is arriving earlier than usual
reading.correct: Because today's Friday is the thirteenth in the series
reading.explain: The same tears and fig gestures repeated almost every Friday, but this thirteenth Friday feels decisive to him.

reading.question: What does the closing line of the chapter say about the journey?
options: That he is getting closer and closer to Petushki
That the train has turned back to Moscow
That he has missed his station
That the train has stopped for good
reading.correct: That he is getting closer and closer to Petushki
reading.explain: The chapter ends with the train drawing nearer to Petushki and his cry to the Queen of Heaven.

highlight.question: Which sentence admits that until then he had known women badly, both tipsy ones and sober ones?
sentences: Черт его знает, я никогда не понимаю толком, в какое мгновение как обратиться с захмелевшей…
До этого – сказать ли вам? – до этого я их плохо знал, и захмелевших, и трезвых.
Я стремился за ними мыслью, но как только устремлялся – сердце останавливалось в испуге.
Помыслы – были, но не было намерений.
highlight.explain: Only the fifth sentence confesses his lack of experience with women of either kind.

highlight.question: Which sentence names the historical grievance against women that spoils Venichka's pleasure?
sentences: С одной стороны, мне нравилось, что у них есть талия, а у нас нет никакой талии, это будило во мне – как бы это назвать? «негу», что ли? – ну да, это будило во мне негу.
Но, с другой стороны, ведь они зарезали Марата перочинным ножиком, а Марат был неподкупен, и резать его не следовало.
highlight.explain: The third sentence brings up the killing of the incorruptible Marat with a penknife; the fourth only states the effect.

highlight.question: Which sentence says what was really inside her once he had got to the bottom of her?
sentences: Случалось, конечно, случалось, что и она была ядовитой, но это все вздор, это все в целях самообороны и чего-то там такого женского – я в этом мало понимаю.
Во всяком случае, когда я ее раскусил до конца, яду там совсем не оказалось, там была малина со сливками.
В одну из пятниц, например, когда я совсем был тепленький от зубровки, я ей сказал: – Давай, давай всю нашу жизнь будем вместе!
highlight.explain: The middle sentence reports that there was no poison in her, only raspberries and cream.

highlight.question: Which sentence gives the reason Venichka expects today to end differently?
sentences: И после того – почти каждую пятницу повторялось все то же: и эти слезы, и эти фиги.
Но сегодня – сегодня что-то решится, потому что сегодняшняя пятница – тринадцатая по счету.
highlight.explain: The second sentence explains that this Friday is the thirteenth one, so something must be decided.
